Meet Danny Cristofano, Founder & Principal Consultant Danny is a seasoned marketing executive with over 25 years of experience driving growth and transformation across diverse tech and lifestyle categories. At Intel, Danny led corporate initiatives and world-class marketing teams through life-changing technology inflection points. His deep and broad range of marketing expertise spans brand management, new product launches and category creation, go-to-market and marketing strategy, sponsorship marketing, global partner ecosystem orchestration and integrated marketing campaigns across Consumer Tech - including sports and entertainment, Enterprise B2B, Internet of Things, AR/VR/Wearables, Healthcare and SaaS, to today's breakneck AI transformation across virtually every industry.
